themes.description: Covers comments about the availability, quality, or usefulness of specific features within the application.
Covers general feedback on the app's design, ease of use, and overall user experience, including positive and negative comments.
Covers concerns about features that encourage risky financial behavior or lead to significant financial losses for users.
This theme covers suggestions for new features, enhancements, or improvements to the app's functionality and offerings.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability or functionality of specific trading tools and features within the application.
Issues related to account creation, activation, unauthorized actions, or general account settings.
Concerns related to the ease of use, navigation, settings management, or general user experience of the application.
This theme covers reviews where users report experiencing financial losses directly attributed to the app's functionality, advice, or unexpected outcomes.
This theme covers feedback related to the user's experience with Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) through the app, including application process, allotment, and overall satisfaction.
Reviews related to the ease of use, clarity, and overall user experience of the application.

Issues related to trade execution, auto-squaring, order processing, and discrepancies in trade rates or outcomes.
Requests or feedback regarding the availability of specific investment products, fund types, or related options within the platform.
This theme covers user suggestions for new functionalities, features, or expansions to the platform's offerings. It includes requests for additional investment options or market access.
This theme covers problems related to downloading, installing, or accessing the application from app stores or due to device compatibility.
This theme covers inquiries or requests regarding the availability of specific investment products, features, or services within the application.
Concerns about the overall trustworthiness, integrity, and reliability of the platform, including accusations of fraud or misleading practices.
This theme includes feedback related to the returns, growth, or overall performance of investments made through the platform.
Reviews related to personal financial gains or losses from investments, market performance, or trading results.
